tier1_postgresql.purpose: real multi-connection transactional acceptance, owner-authority, ambiguity, history reconciliation, physical PITR and relocation-fence evidence

tier2_timescale.purpose: candidate tenant-isolation, background-job, fresh-cluster restore, relocation-completeness and bounded capacity-profile falsification

classification_basis.final_package_gate_requirement: The exact final package HEAD, including this manifest and reviewer documentation, must independently rerun both gates before review/acceptance.
classification_basis.note: The empirical anchor includes immutable observation-content and owner-authority repairs, durable live poll claims, contiguous/current late-history reconciliation from the supported history floor, fresh-cluster Timescale restore/role reconstruction, lock-before-fence relocation ordering, and gap-free target completeness via durable count+digest+max receipt.

late_history_evidence.coverage_semantics: only overlapping/touching reconciliation windows form continuous coverage; a later disjoint window cannot jump an unswept interval
late_history_evidence.high_only_negative_vector: 11:55..12:00 sweep left anchored reconciliation coverage NULL and could not finalize
late_history_evidence.disjoint_negative_vector: supported_history_floor..10:00 plus 11:55..12:00 left contiguous coverage at 10:00 even though max(window_to)=12:00; finalization rejected
late_history_evidence.bridge_vector: 10:00..12:00 sweep closed the gap, recovered the delayed 10:30 observation and established contiguous coverage through 12:00
late_history_evidence.snapshot_currentness_negative_vector: finalization requiring reconciliation snapshot >=12:16 was rejected when covering sweeps were only current through 12:15
late_history_evidence.unrecoverable_retention_loss: explicit durable gap; never false complete

relocation_evidence.fence_derivation: placement authority locked before F is derived
relocation_evidence.inflight_acceptance_race: acceptance holding placement lock commits before fence and is included in F
relocation_evidence.negative_gap_vector: target reached max=F with missing lower rows; receipt remained incomplete and activation was rejected
relocation_evidence.completion_receipt: durable authoritative count+ordered identity digest+target count+target digest+target max, revalidated under frozen authority

required_security_shape: no direct tenant-facing privilege on shared raw history
no direct tenant-facing privilege on continuous aggregate or internal materialization
tenant binding outside caller-writable SQL state
separate NOLOGIN mediation owner and least-privilege LOGIN automation owner
tenant-facing/runtime roles have no owner membership, CREATEROLE, SUPERUSER or BYPASSRLS
backup/restore role topology is reconstructed in a fresh cluster rather than inherited from the source cluster
same isolation attacks repeat after background jobs, fresh-cluster restore and restored-job execution

bounded_capacity_observation.interpretation: Mechanism-level bounded fitness evidence only. These values are not production SLOs, limits, retention settings, cardinality envelopes or sizing commitments. Production envelopes remain OPEN-REL-020 C3.

decision_recommendation.tier1: accept PostgreSQL transactional acceptance/outbox/current-state pattern as OPEN-REL-030 Tier 1 mechanism only with immutable canonical observation content, owner-controlled source generation/epoch, durable live poll-claim admission resolved in-transaction, contiguous/current reconciliation coverage anchored at the supported history floor, and lock-before-F relocation fencing, after exact-head review and explicit Track B acceptance
decision_recommendation.tier2: accept TimescaleDB historical projection only under the conformed mediated shared-history profile, including fresh-cluster restore role reconstruction and count+digest+max relocation completeness receipts, after exact-head review and explicit Track B acceptance
rejected_assumptions: do not treat RLS on a pooled raw hypertable as automatically compatible with or inherited by columnstore/continuous-aggregate surfaces
do not treat same-cluster database restore as evidence that cluster-global role topology can be safely reconstructed
do not derive relocation F before acquiring the authority lock that excludes later source acceptance
do not treat max(target_ordinal)=F as proof that every authoritative observation through F exists on the target
do not treat max(reconciliation window_to) as proof of contiguous history coverage from supported_history_floor
do not reuse reconciliation windows older than the snapshot currentness required by finalization
decision_recommendation.reversibility: Tier 2 remains behind the telemetry projection seam; replacement must preserve canonical observation identity, idempotent historical projection, contiguous/current reconciliation evidence, complete-set relocation receipts, tenant isolation and recovery/relocation semantics
